result.summary: No priority inversion or CPU preemption seen in 24 snapshot(s) (rules: mutex and message-passing priority inversion, CPU preemption). This does not prove there is none; it was not observed. In 7 snapshot(s) a server ran at its waiting client's priority, as QNX's priority inheritance through message passing does: e.g. 'S-server' at priority 30 (RUNNING) while 'A-control' (priority 30) waited for its reply. A kernel trace (1000 ms) was captured; there was no finding to check against it.
